Children start from an argv (auto_argv: shlex split, no shell, python3 word -> sys.executable), each in its own group (_proc_group.group_kwargs), output to <state>.auto.log, waited on by polling; SIGTERM/SIGINT only set a flag (auto_arm), the wait tears down every live group (_proc_group.tear_down), and auto answers stop (auto-interrupted) with the task left in progress. A non-zero child is reported on stderr and goes back through next. Same step+subject+run commands past AUTO_REPEAT_BOUND runs is the named stop auto-no-progress. Exit answers AUTO_DONE/AUTO_STOP/AUTO_NEEDS_MODEL, E_USAGE for could-not-run/crash, each in auto --help. stdout on done/stop is explain_text of the step's explain (equal to next --explain, asserted au1/au2b/au20/au21); on needs-model the signal line. gate_in_background reads ctx["auto"]: every gate running anything is a child step inside auto, next's choice untouched (au9 twin). wait-writer's and writer_wait's docstrings say what auto knows.
